about.title: Kouye keda Akitogogong
about.content: Ageun kotoma okaru 2018, TEWOYEI ageun kwape egiriko loangor lueitingerete aibwo keda akitogogong. Aboikin isio ebe atiokisio nueloliete angor - kwape akitameun aidis, akitagalakin keda ailatit - ekotos ebeit aiswama nuepolok.
about.pillars: Apilae nuepolok: Aiyun, Adup keda Aitidau.
about.intro: TEWOYEI ekamuni apilae aiyun, adup keda aitidau, keda akiro nukitalakinit aijarakin etunga luemitakina kotoma etem.
about.introSecond: Isio erai ekiror loangor loeswama aitogogong etem kotoma aidis nueijarakin angor keda atukot neejeni aitoron.
about.missionText: Aijarakin etem keda aidis nueyapakin angor keda atukot neejeni aitoron.
about.historyFirst: Ageun kotoma okaru 2018, TEWOYEI ageun kwape egiriko loangor lueitingerete aibwo kotoma Teso sub-region, Uganda.
about.historySecond: Aboikin isio ebe atiokisio nueloliete angor ekotos ebeit aiswama nuepolok, isio ajulakini ekiror lo Community Based Organization aijarakin luemitakina.
about.leadershipIntro: TEWOYEI iritio keda founder members keda Board of Directors luetacakin aswam, health, social work, keda accountability kotoma etem.

home.testimonialQuote: TEWOYEI ajulakina ajokakina. Akisiyoma aijon, kanu emamori ijokon nuijarakin apese ka keda asomero kotoma agogong kon.
home.fieldStoriesDescription: Angolokin aswam, agogong, keda aijarakin nuka atukot kosi kosoman kotoma Teso.

programs.headerSubtitle: Isio itogogong angor keda atukot kotoma aidis nueijarakin etem, ajokis keda aitoron.
objectives: Aijarakin airit ejok keda public policies nuejok
Aitogogong etem kanu aisodit Gender Based Violence keda child marriage
Aitogogong angor kanu airit kotoma etem
Aijarakin victims of war, GBV, human torture, natural calamities, OVCs keda luce
Aijarakin sexuality education kotoma asomero keda etem
Aitolomun child health clubs kanu advocacy keda aisisian akiro nu adolescent girls
Ainyikok keda organizations keda government kotoma rights nuka apese.
thematicAreas: Akitogogong angor keda atukot kotoma livelihood keda sustainability.
Cross cutting issues (GBV, Health, OVCs, PLWDS, Climate and Environment, PLWHIV/AIDS, Widows).
currentActivities: Community engagements keda sensitization on GBV
Community keda school engagements on Menstrual cups keda SRHR
District engagement on CLM kotoma Kapelebyong district kotoma 8 Health facilities.
Skilling of youth keda vulnerable women (tailoring, building, concrete practice, sweater making, knitting, hairdressing, beading, bakery)
Trainings on mindset change kanu youth keda parents
Radio dramas aisisian etem on impact of Covid 19 keda GBV
Training on how to make reusable pads for girls keda vulnerable women
Sensitizing communities on malaria prevention keda treatment services in Okungur Sub County, Agonga keda Airabet.
plannedActivities: Aisisia keda aijulakin menstrual cup training and distribution
Aimalar skilling project in Amuria keda Kapelebyong district.
Aisisia community sensitizations on GBV awareness.
Aiswama SRHR trainings keda sensitizations kotoma etem keda asomero.
achievements: Menstrual cup project kotoma Okungur subcounty keda Obalanga Town council (300 cups distributed).
Mapping exercise keda mobilization of 40 CBOs for Lango region under KAL Consortium Africa.
Implementing 2 yr CLM project funded by Global Fund under TASO through CDFU in Kapelebyong District.
Malaria project in Kapelebyong district, Okungur Subcounty supported by TASO Uganda through CDFU funded by GLOBAL FUND.
Menstrual health project in 4 schools from Kapelebyong district, supported by USAID through East West Management Institute.
Trained 1,361 youths in Amuria (787) keda Kapelebyong (574) districts; 1,010 females keda 351 males.
Supported 10 highly vulnerable youths from Akeriau, Ogongora, keda Okungur to acquire skills.
Included PWDs who are successfully coping with the training.
Sensitized communities on COVID-19 impact on GBV, producing 8 radio dramas.
Trained 05 girls and women in brick laying and concrete practice.
Participated in 16 Days of Activism campaign.
Trained 80 women on baking bread and knitting.
Sensitized over 1500 people on malaria prevalence in Airabet and Agonga.
challenges: Limited funds to facilitate activities within sub counties of operation.
Negative attitude towards contributing for trainings by the community.
Few staff members for monitoring project activities.
Lack of office equipment like computer, printer, photocopying machine among others.
